vardsidan.forkl_svarighet: How dangerous the tower is: lives, how often new rooms have traps and creatures, how many sleep and wake cards the serpent deck has, how hard the serpent bites and how much treasure is lost when it wakes. Normal is the data files as they are.
vardsidan.forkl_ai: Computer-controlled wanderers who fill in when you are few. They only see what a human sees, get no clues and never whisper. If the tower is full when a human arrives, one of them makes room. At most seven, or eight in keeper mode.
vardsidan.forkl_spelledarlage: You lead the tower instead of playing. You see everything on the keeper's table, start the wandering and can intervene: time, the serpent, the revelation, the tower's voice and rooms. Nobody can play from this computer, and the players learn that the tower has a keeper.
vardsidan.forkl_sprak: The language of the game, the keeper page and the keeper's table. Changes at once in the lobby, otherwise from the next tower.
vardsidan.forkl_min: This many wanderers, AI players included, must be present before the wandering starts by itself when everyone is ready. Start now starts it anyway.
vardsidan.forkl_avslojande: The tower holds a secret that shows itself gradually as the sun sinks, in four levels: rooms, sounds and the map change, the wanderers get different clues and omens about nearby rooms, and the epilogue tells all. Turn it off for those who only want the treasure, the serpent and the dark. Initiation and the changing tower go with it.
vardsidan.forkl_invigning: Whoever understands the secret can whisper it to the tower with V and become initiated, with advantages and a drawback. The serpent's name: each wandering has its own name in three parts handed out to the wanderers, and the whisper must contain it. Whoever kills another wanderer takes their parts, and when everyone left inside is initiated the serpent sleeps deeper. Fixed answers: the same words work every time, best for the first evening.
vardsidan.forkl_forandras: The tower grows more dangerous towards the end: from level 3 some traps become more common in new rooms, and at the last level the gates close one by one, with a warning the round before. The last gate never closes.
vardsidan.forkl_franvaro: What happens to a human who loses the connection during the wandering: an AI player takes over after this many rounds, or the wanderer stands still until the human returns.
vardsidan.forkl_strid: Whether wanderers can fight each other in the same room, with the same choices as against creatures. A hit takes a third of the opponent's gold and a killing blow takes all of it. Every round with fighting makes the serpent more restless. After half the time: only once the sun has sunk halfway.
vardsidan.forkl_synlighet: What the wanderers see of each other. Own map: others are only seen in the same room, and the map only shows rooms you have walked through yourself. Only when they meet: all rooms anyone has found are shown. Always: everyone sees everyone.
vardsidan.forkl_karta: How the map is drawn for the wanderers and at the game master's table. Straight from above is the chalk map on the slate. From an angle shows the tower in 3D, with walls, gates and figures. It needs WebGL, and a device without it shows the flat map.
vardsidan.forkl_storlek: How many rooms the tower has. Automatic chooses by the number of wanderers: 9 × 9 for up to four, 11 × 11 for five or six and 13 × 13 for seven or eight. A tower is never too small.
vardsidan.forkl_sol: How many rounds you have before the sun sets. Anyone still inside then is lost, and treasure only counts if carried out. Automatic gives 40, 50 or 60 rounds by the size of the tower. The levels of the revelation follow the sun.
vardsidan.forkl_turtid: The longest time to choose a move. The round is settled as soon as everyone has chosen, so the turn time is only a ceiling. Automatic gives 30 seconds for up to four humans, 35 for five or six and 40 for seven or eight.
vardsidan.forkl_klasser: Whether the wanderers choose a class after the lobby, from one card for each class and with a time limit. Each class has a strength and a weakness. Off: everyone is an ordinary wanderer.
vardsidan.hjalp_wifi: Check that everyone is on the same wifi. Guest networks often stop devices from reaching each other.
vardsidan.hjalp_local: If the name with .local does not work, try the address with numbers.
vardsidan.hjalp_macos: Did macOS ask whether the game may accept network connections? Then you must have answered Allow. You can change it under System Settings → Network → Firewall.
vardsidan.hjalp_tappar: Anyone who loses the connection goes back to the address and types the same name again.
